```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(compositions)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
```

## Load data
```{r}
load("../manuscript/data/clinical.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/microbiome_metadata.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/counts-wide.rds")
load("../manuscript/data/events.rds")
```

## Prepare data... 
- CLR transformation? or use RA
- Need to define time points 

```{r}
taxa <- counts.w %>%
  column_to_rownames("microbe")

# add pseudo count for CLR transformation 
taxa[taxa == 0] <- 1 
clr_taxa <- t(apply(taxa, 1, function(x) clr(x)))

# Remove 0 variance taxa - n=891
non_constant_taxa <- apply(clr_taxa, 1, function(x) var(x, na.rm = TRUE)) > 0
clr_taxa_filt <- clr_taxa[non_constant_taxa, ]
```

## Clustering

# PCA 

```{r}
pca_result <- prcomp(t(clr_taxa_filt), center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_df$sample <- rownames(pca_df)

pca_df <- merge(pca_df, mic.meta, by = "sample")
pca_df <- merge(pca_df, demographics, by = "Patient Id")

# Plot PCA (color by PersonID or Timepoint)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = `Patient Id`)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) + 
  theme_minimal()
```
One major outlier M018, Sample FF08034405


# Heirarchical
```{r}
sample_dist <- dist(t(clr_taxa_filt), method = "euclidean")
sample_clustering <- hclust(sample_dist, method = "ward.D2")
pheatmap(as.matrix(sample_dist), clustering_method = "ward.D2")
```
